ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of $2.74 to the rider for the unexempted off-route segment (RydeTAXI metered mileage refund), and keep the remaining $26.37 of the $29.11 fare unchanged; no account flag.
ruling.reasoning:
This is a metered RydeTAXI trip (Orchard Road → NUS, 09:43–10:03, $29.11) and the record contains exactly one off-route segment: 09:47–09:53, 3.83 km driven where the optimal route covers 1.89 km, +1.94 km, straying up to 777 m [F3][F6][RD-1]. RD-1 sets no threshold, and both advocates as well as the trace agree this segment is the only candidate for review [F3][RD-1].

The RD-4 reasonable-cause branch fails on the record: there is no traffic incident on the replaced stretch of the optimal route, so RD-4(a) is not met [F12][RD-4]; the only traffic entries are speed band 4 (30–39 km/h) on Ayer Rajah Expressway and Kent Ridge Road, i.e. neither band 1 nor band 2, so RD-4(b) cannot exempt the segment either [F10][F11][RD-4]; weather was fair [F13][RD-4].

No exemption under RD-5 or RD-3 is available. The single pre-segment rider message, 09:35, is a pickup arrangement at the kerb outside Mandarin Gallery naming no road, route or stop [F7][F8][RD-5][RD-3]. The driver's own post-trip statement that his GPS rerouted him is a claim, not rider consent, and it appears only in his statement (G11) [F9][RD-5]. No general route authorisation, named road, or rider-named stop is on the record, and no stop was measured in the segment, so the segment counts [F3][F7][RD-3][RD-5]. Both advocates jointly stipulate the ground consent_after_or_none → counts for F3, which is consistent with the chat record [F3][F7][F8].

Quantum follows RD-2 for RydeTAXI: the unexempted segment's extra km at this trip's own per-km rate. The rate is the fare record's distance fare ÷ distance km: $18.50 ÷ 13.12 km = $1.4101/km (as stated in the fare fact) [F6][F4][RD-2]. 1.94 km × $1.4101/km = $2.7356 → $2.74 [F3][F4][RD-2]. The billed excess distance of $3.44 on 2.44 km [F4] is not refunded in full: the ~0.50 km residue is corridor/map-matching mileage outside any segment, which RD-2 expressly excludes, and the trip-level +2.4 km gap [F1] is likewise not the measure [F2][F4][RD-2].

RD-6 does not attach: the driver's profile shows 2 disputes in 90 days with 1 upheld, but 0 route disputes upheld, so route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 and the "repeated" precondition is not met; the profile cannot decide the case in any event [F15][RD-6]. The fare contains only published items and waiting was $0.00, so no FARE-1 or NS-6 issue arises [F6][FARE-1]. Safety screen: I read the rider's message, the driver's statement and the complaint — the Mandarin Gallery/red jacket line is a locator, not a threat, and nothing in the record alleges threats, harassment or dangerous driving, so safety_concern is none [F7][F9][SAFE-1]. Evidence is sufficient: the one segment is measured, the rate and fare items are recorded, and the chat record is complete and fully timestamped [F3][F4][F6][F8].

segment_findings.reason: The only rider message before the 09:47:50 segment start is the 09:35 pickup arrangement naming no road, route or stop [F7][F8]; the driver's post-trip 'my GPS rerouted me' statement is a claim, not rider consent [F9]; no general route authorisation and no rider-named stop exists, and no stop was measured [F3][F7]. RD-5 gives no exemption; RD-3(a) does not apply. The segment's 1.94 extra km is refundable under RD-2.

Accepted as to the segment reading but the trip-level +2.4 km / +23% gap [F1] is not the refund measure; only F3's 1.94 km enters the RD-2 calculation [F1][F3][RD-2].

Rejected insofar as it invites treating the unexplained +2.4 km trip gap as excused corridor variation; the gap outside the measured segment is simply not refunded, not exonerated [F1][F3][F4][RD-1][RD-2].

Rejected as a defence: speed band 4 (30–39 km/h) on Ayer Rajah Expressway and Kent Ridge Road is neither band 1 nor band 2 and cannot exempt, and no traffic incident was recorded on the replaced stretch; RD-4 gives no reasonable cause [F10][F11][F12][F13][RD-4].

Accepted only in part: no flag_account attaches (RD-6 precondition unmet) [F15][RD-6], but the driver's no-prior-route-dispute point does not negate the RD-2 refund of $2.74 owed for the unexempted segment [F3][F4][RD-2].
